title: A loan drawn mid-year and pay-later buys on two plans at once: a borrow or a spend raises what is owed, each payment day asks the parts of every plan (final_review_2 S3, S3b, decision Q3)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 100,000. A credit line (a loan, no interest) is set up owing nothing; when owed, 25,000 is paid on the 27th from the bank. A pay-later account (no interest) is set up owing nothing, paid on the 20th from the bank; its plans are a list: a fridge of 30,000 in 3 parts of 10,000 from 20 Feb, and a phone of 30,000 in 6 parts of 5,000 from 20 Mar. On Fri 5 Feb the fridge is bought on the pay-later account. On Sat 20 Feb the first fridge part of 10,000 is paid (ticked). On Mon 1 Mar the person draws 500,000 on the credit line into the bank (a borrow); on Mon 8 Mar the bank statement is read and its 500,000 line in attaches to the borrow's bank side. On Fri 5 Mar the phone is bought on the pay-later account. No fixed pay, no Free to spend amount. Every amount is made up.

events.note: bank statement: 500,000 in from the credit line

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 0 (opening) + 30,000 (fridge bought Fri 5 Feb, a spend on the pay-later account) = 30,000
asks.note: Before Q3 the buy was ignored and the pay-later account owed 0.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.note: No fixed pay: the next 30 days. The credit line owes nothing, so its 27 Feb payment day asks nothing.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 100,000 (opening) - 10,000 (fridge part 1, Sat 20 Feb) + 500,000 (drawn on the credit line, Mon 1 Mar; the statement line attaches to the borrow's bank side) = 590,000

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 0 (opening) + 500,000 (drawn Mon 1 Mar, a borrow raises what is owed) = 500,000
asks.note: Before Q3 a borrow raised only a card, and the credit line still owed 0 (final_review_2 S3).

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 15,000 (Pay-later 20 Mar: fridge part 2 of 10,000 and phone part 1 of 5,000, the plans list) + 25,000 (Credit line 27 Mar, its usual payment) = 40,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 590,000 (Bank today) - 15,000 (Pay-later 20 Mar) - 25,000 (Credit line 27 Mar) - 15,000 (Pay-later 20 Apr: fridge part 3 and phone part 2) = 535,000
asks.note: No fixed pay: the walk runs to Thu 22 Apr (today + 45 days); the credit line's 27 Apr payment is after it.
